rules.scope: Copy explicit supported source fields with JSON-pointer lineage; no meaning inferred from names.
ASCII lexical GTIN 8/12/13/14; modulo-10 check; left-pad valid syntax to 14 as an alias only. Retain all source zeros and namespace. No allocation, issuer, supplier, manufacturer or origin inference.

Bounded decimal values and ordered ranges; exact g/mL/s/J prefixes and absolute/interval Celsius/Kelvin/Fahrenheit. Rational output avoids rounding. Explicit positive density plus requested g/mL target required across dimensions. No locale spoon/cup, oz or arbitrary unit conversions.

Explicit nutrient observations; per-100-g, per-100-mL and per-serving remain distinct; unresolved bases remain unresolved. No salt/sodium, energy, serving-weight, nutrient-identity or suitability derivation.
Original language/name/aliases/preparation and source IDs stay separate; cilantro/coriander/leaf/seed are not automatically equated. No dictionary-based identity collapse or fuzzy merge.
Keep explicit organization, supplier entity, place, ownership and price-observation assertions distinct; no live-offer, ownership or user-supplier inference.

HTTP(S) scheme/ASCII authority case only. Preserve query, percent escapes, path, explicit port, trailing slash, fragment and original string. Parent references and rights claims stay distinct; no rights clearance.
Require explicit namespace and household ID; keep private user/profile/inventory assertions scoped; never merge across households or infer preferences.
Only exact same namespace/value and explicit authoritative flags may produce a link candidate; private scope must agree; no automatic entity merging or authority inference.

limits: No external AI invocation or simulated review; unresolved cases belong in the actual AI queue.
Every output requires review; engine is solely responsible for source-version/rule-version cache identity and gold gates.
No serving-factor, density, botanical synonym, all-world ingredient, dietary or supplier ontology is embedded.
Generated fixtures only; passing tests is not evidence that actual retained corpora were normalized.
